description: Search the voices for text_to_speech: the library of 12,000+ MiniMax, ElevenLabs and Fish voices (name, language, gender, preview URL), the Kling voices for kling-tts (provider "kling"), or your own cloned voices (mine: true). Free. Pass the returned id as voice_id.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. en, zh, ja, es.

mine.description: List only your own voices: ElevenLabs and Fish clones from clone_voice, and Kling custom voices made on apimodels.app. MiniMax clones are not listable — keep the voice_id clone_voice returned.

provider.description: Only voices for this TTS family (minimax-speech-*, eleven-tts-*, fish-*, kling-tts). Kling voices come from their own list (language filter only).

q.description: Free-text search on name / description, e.g. "warm narrator" or "news".

name: list_voices
